verdict.rationale: TWC runs online tax services and offers installable software (QuickFile), so an official CLI is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows TWC ships a command-line interface. QuickFile is described only as installable software for reporting from a formatted file, which is adjacent at best, and the probes found no machine-oriented surfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
